rubric.evidence: Every mechanism claim traces to a primary source fetched 2026-08-09: codec-string grammar quoted from IAMF spec section 6.4 (spec HTML fetched and grepped); parser acceptance/rejection read line-by-line from ParseIamfCodecId in audio_codecs.cc; container structure verified against the spec's IASampleEntry/IAConfigurationBox definitions; decoder behavior (kUnsupportedCodec/kUnsupportedEncryptionMode/kUnsupportedConfig, kInt32LittleEndian, layout mapping, kEnableHighChannelLayouts fallback) grepped from iamf_audio_decoder.cc; the M152 flag state read from branch-heads/7977 media_switches.cc. The enable-step feature string IamfAudioDecoding is derived from the documented 2-arg BASE_FEATURE macro semantics in base/feature.h, not guessed.

Feature id 5113656292540416 appears in the milestone=152 listing under 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' (verified 2026-08-09) with the exact listing name used as H1 and slug. The dual listing at 153 ('Enabled by default') is disclosed in the warn-block, at-a-glance, and compat table, with the v153 page framed as canonical throughout.

reference-contract.json declares 5 inventory items (playback capability, v152 enablement contract, codecs parameter, ISO-BMFF encapsulation, decode/render algorithm) x 9 dimensions, all documented with selectors resolving on this page. The feature has no new JS API, so the surface is the grammar/behavior/enablement contract. Deep member docs are intentionally NOT duplicated from the v153 tree; the codecs-parameter deep dive is linked, but this page's own #syntax section carries enough of the grammar and parser contract to build from standalone.

The v152 angle is stated in the first paragraph and enforced everywhere: the warn-block gives the exact enable path (--enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding), explains why there is no chrome://flags or --enable-blink-features route (both greps clean, cited), and frames 153 as the ship milestone with a prominent canonical cross-link section near the top.

Complete isTypeSupported-gated MSE snippet whose fallback branch is the honest un-flagged-152 path; valid and rejected codec strings enumerated from the parser source; spec-quoted IASampleEntry pre block; runnable material linked (AOM binaural web demo and two Chromium test bitstreams, all verified HTTP 200 on 2026-08-09).

No BCD entry (published data.json fetched from unpkg, 19.9 MB, zero case-insensitive iamf matches) and no webstatus.dev feature (zero matches), both verified 2026-08-09 and stated; the interim table separates Chrome 152 (flagged) from Chrome 153 (listed default) rows and links the M152 branch flag state as evidence; the example's fallback branch shows what to serve when detection fails.

Zero unlinked source labels: every citation is a direct <a href> to the artifact (spec anchors, branch-pinned Chromium source, base/feature.h, listings, API record, RFC, test media). The docs.google.com design doc on the ChromeStatus record was deliberately not linked (Google-internal, resourcekey-gated). Showcase routes are linked as plain text links with their 404-at-build-time status stated, not embedded.

Single h1, sequential h2/h3 outline; baseline banner uses role=note with aria-label; tables use th scope=row/col inside .table-wrap scroll containers; pre blocks scroll internally; all colors come from public/styles.css variables (WCAG AA per repo invariant), including the amber warn-block treatment shared with the sibling page.

overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/inline code for the long feature name and codec strings; .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with table-layout:fixed keeps wide tables from forcing page-level horizontal scroll; desktop screenshot (1280px) captured and read during self-verify; DOM grep confirmed the mandatory chromestatus link.

Both chrome-platform-showcase routes for this feature (v152 and v153) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-09, so no iframe is embedded per the 200-only rule; the page links both routes with their status stated and substitutes the AOM binaural web demo (200) and Chromium test bitstreams as runnable material.

openQuestions: The v153 sibling page's warn-block says to launch with --enable-features=IAMFAudioDecoding; the 2-arg BASE_FEATURE macro (base/feature.h) derives the name 'IamfAudioDecoding' from kIamfAudioDecoding, so this page uses that casing. base::FeatureList name matching is case-sensitive — the sibling's casing should be checked and, if wrong, fixed as a targeted in-place edit (integrator to confirm).

kIamfAudioDecoding is FEATURE_DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT on trunk AND branch-heads/7977 with no about_flags or fieldtrial_testing_config entry (2026-08-09) — consistent with 'developer trial' at 152, but the mechanism that flips 153 to 'Enabled by default' is still not visible in public source; recheck after M153 branches settle.
Whether WebCodecs AudioDecoder accepts iamf.* codec strings is deliberately unclaimed on this page (not verified in source).

chromestatus browsers.chrome.desktop/android/webview all say 153; the 152 listing position is what places this page at v152 per the milestone-gating invariant — worth noting so nobody 'corrects' the folder from the detail fields.
